title: Renewed Scythes
description: This plugin adds a new tools for every material called Scythes with reverse knockback dragging your enemies towards you.
body:
*   **Harvesting Pull:** Attacking enemies draws them vertically and horizontally toward you, harvesting their positioning.
*   **Shield Piercing:** Scythe strikes automatically break and drop active player shields on a 6-second cooldown.
*   **Crescent Blood Slash:** Right-clicking with a *Netherite Scythe* consumes raw player health to project a wide, geometric crescent wave of blood-red and abyssal-black particles that pierces targets and transfers active potion effects from the caster to victims.
